audit_result.proof_trace: claimTokenAllocation applies whenSaleResultsArePublished (L261) but omits whenTokensSupplied, which is explicitly present on withdrawRaisedCapital (L202-203). The internal _verifyCanClaimTokenAllocation (L710-740) also makes no reference to s_saleStatus.tokensSupplied. The only runtime barrier is that SafeTransferLib.safeTransfer would revert on insufficient askToken balance, but this is not an explicit guard and is bypassed if any prior askToken balance exists in the contract or if amount=0 with a valid Merkle proof.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker directly transfers askToken to the contract before the project calls supplyTokens; an investor with a valid Merkle proof then calls claimTokenAllocation, succeeds with hasSettled=true set, drains the pre-positioned balance, and is permanently locked out of claiming from the official supply when it arrives.

PROP-legion-backe-pre-007.text: OpenApp claimTokenAllocation requires saleResultsPublished AND tokensSupplied.
